capability.summary: Average one CSV value column by one index column
capability.description: Reads a CSV with pandas defaults, builds a pivot table using one index column, one values column, and a fixed mean aggregation, then returns the reset-index table as CSV text.
capability.problem_space: Single-key mean aggregation of one value column from a file-backed CSV table.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: CSV path, one index-column name, and one value-column name; output: wrapper JSON containing the mean-aggregated table as CSV text under csv.
accepted_inputs: a readable CSV parseable by pandas.read_csv defaults
existing column names identifying one grouping index and one mean-aggregated value column
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.pandas_pivot", and csv as a header-bearing CSV string for the reset-index mean pivot table. A caught file-read, CSV-parse, missing-column, mean-aggregation, or serialization exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.pandas_pivot", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: uses a fixed mean aggregation and cannot select sum, count, median, multiple aggregations, or custom functions
accepts only one index column and one values column and does not expose pandas pivot_table's columns dimension
uses fixed pandas.read_csv defaults with no delimiter, encoding, dtype, or missing-value options
returns CSV content inside the wrapper response rather than writing a CSV file
missing columns, non-aggregatable values, read failures, and pandas errors use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: CSV text containing one grouping column and the mean of one selected value column.

intent_tags: average a CSV column by another column
create a one-index pandas mean pivot table
negative_intents: build a two-dimensional pivot with column categories
choose an aggregation other than mean
summarize every CSV column with descriptive statistics

output_contract.description: CSV text containing one grouping column and the mean of one selected value column.
